# Nikhil Sahani

> Senior Product Engineer based in Thane / Mumbai, India with 7+ years of experience building distributed backends, system internals, and practical AI tooling.

Nikhil Sahani (also known as h4r0015k) specializes in distributed systems, backend infrastructure, and local-first software. His production focus is on backend architecture: keeping systems fast, handling scale, maintaining transaction safety, and building clean, reliable software that runs quietly without drama.

## Core Pages & Notes
- [Homepage](https://nikhilsahani.com/): Primary portfolio, background, and overview of production tools and systems experiments.
- [Notes Archive](https://nikhilsahani.com/notes/): Occasional scratchpad notes on bugs, architecture decisions, and tooling write-ups.
- [Resolving Prod Issues Automatically Using Claude Routines](https://nikhilsahani.com/notes/resolving-prod-issues-automatically-using-claude-routines/): Technical note detailing a real-world pipeline using Pino, SolarWinds Papertrail, and Claude routines to investigate production 5xx errors and open draft pull requests automatically.

## Software Projects
- [Mountain](https://nikhilsahani.com/Mountain/): Local-first, zero-knowledge browser password vault using Web Crypto API with AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2, and BIP-39 recovery in client-side IndexedDB.
- [Mountain Source Code](https://github.com/h4r0015k/Mountain): GitHub repository for the Mountain zero-knowledge password vault.
- [Memory Allocator Source Code](https://github.com/h4r0015k/Memory): Custom heap memory allocator in ANSI C implementing malloc, free, realloc, and calloc, tested via LD_PRELOAD.
- [IRCBot-C Source Code](https://github.com/h4r0015k/IRCBot-C): Minimal RFC 1459 IRC client in ANSI C over raw POSIX/BSD sockets handling direct TCP streams.
- [WhatBot Source Code](https://github.com/h4r0015k/WhatBot): Automated WhatsApp cryptocurrency micro-tipping bot with Python, Yowsup, MySQL, and Block.io APIs.
